<?php
/**
 * Plugin Name: WPAX Small Business Starter
 * Description: Exposes business info via REST API (/wpax/v1/business-info) and WordPress Abilities API (wpax/get-business-info).
 * Version: 1.0.0
 */

if ( ! defined( 'ABSPATH' ) ) {
	exit;
}

function wpax_get_business_info_data(): array {
	return array(
		'name'        => get_bloginfo( 'name' ),
		'tagline'     => get_bloginfo( 'description' ),
		'address'     => '412 Market Street, Suite B',
		'phone'       => '(555) 014-8920',
		'email'       => 'hello@hearthstonebakery.example',
		'hours'       => array(
			'tuesday_friday' => '07:00 - 17:00',
			'saturday'       => '08:00 - 16:00',
			'sunday'         => '08:00 - 14:00',
			'monday'         => 'Closed',
		),
		'services'    => array(
			array(
				'name'        => 'Daily Sourdough & Pastries',
				'description' => 'Naturally leavened country loaves, croissants, and seasonal tarts baked fresh every morning.',
			),
			array(
				'name'        => 'Custom Celebration Cakes',
				'description' => 'Made-to-order seasonal layer cakes available with 48 hours advance notice.',
			),
			array(
				'name'        => 'Neighborhood Catering',
				'description' => 'Pastry boxes, sandwich platters, and batch-brewed coffee for local offices and events.',
			),
		),
	);
}

add_filter(
	'wp_insert_post_data',
	static function ( array $data ): array {
		if ( isset( $data['post_type'] ) && 'page' === $data['post_type'] && empty( $data['ID'] ) ) {
			$data['comment_status'] = 'closed';
			$data['ping_status']    = 'closed';
		}
		return $data;
	}
);

add_action(
	'rest_api_init',
	static function (): void {
		register_rest_route(
			'wpax/v1',
			'/business-info',
			array(
				'methods'             => WP_REST_Server::READABLE,
				'callback'            => static function (): WP_REST_Response {
					return new WP_REST_Response( wpax_get_business_info_data(), 200 );
				},
				'permission_callback' => '__return_true',
			)
		);
	}
);

add_action(
	'wp_abilities_api_categories_init',
	static function (): void {
		if ( function_exists( 'wp_register_ability_category' ) ) {
			wp_register_ability_category(
				'wpax',
				array(
					'label'       => 'WPAX Site Capabilities',
					'description' => 'Structured WordPress site abilities registered by WPAX starter blueprints.',
				)
			);
		}
	}
);

add_action(
	'wp_abilities_api_init',
	static function (): void {
		if ( function_exists( 'wp_register_ability' ) && function_exists( 'wp_register_ability_category' ) ) {
			wp_register_ability(
				'wpax/get-business-info',
				array(
					'label'               => 'Get Business Info',
					'description'         => 'Returns opening hours, contact details, and offered services for the small business site.',
					'category'            => 'wpax',
					'input_schema'        => array(
						'type'                 => 'object',
						'properties'           => array(),
						'additionalProperties' => false,
					),
					'output_schema'       => array(
						'type'       => 'object',
						'properties' => array(
							'name'     => array( 'type' => 'string' ),
							'tagline'  => array( 'type' => 'string' ),
							'address'  => array( 'type' => 'string' ),
							'phone'    => array( 'type' => 'string' ),
							'email'    => array( 'type' => 'string' ),
							'hours'    => array( 'type' => 'object' ),
							'services' => array( 'type' => 'array' ),
						),
					),
					'execute_callback'    => static function (): array {
						return wpax_get_business_info_data();
					},
					'permission_callback' => '__return_true',
					'meta'                => array(
						'annotations'  => array(
							'readonly' => true,
						),
						'show_in_rest' => true,
					),
				)
			);
		}
	}
);
